title: Preserve vector-output preimage counts without a variable per gate
statement: For t<=Cn compiled outputs moduloq=2^b, character orthogonality expresses exact target-preimage count as q^-t times a local-phase sum on n+bt=O(n) bits with locality<=k+1 and at most bm+bt monomial gates.

provides: For t<=Cn compiled outputs moduloq=2^b, character orthogonality expresses exact target-preimage count as q^-t times a local-phase sum on n+bt=O(n) bits with locality<=k+1 and at most bm+bt monomial gates.
assumptions: Complete program expansion and acceptance checks are charged
Compute all needed characters; a single primitive character does not determine a q-valued histogram
costs: Compilation O_k,b(S n^(2k)) coefficient operations; precision N+2 before exact division
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; exact binary/cyclotomic/finite-field arithmetic and source-local rank parameters. No physical resource conversion.
contract.obstruction: SAT encoding would introduce one independent counting variable per intermediate state.

body: Character bits encode output constraints only. Arbitrarily promised sparse final support is not an efficient compiler.
